summary: Projects filtering and classification enhancement. Adds composable project grouping and entry/source filtering while preserving existing lifecycle/action-state filters. Classification is derived from existing project_code, resource_kind, runtime host and source_ref; no schema or persisted truth is added. Shared Shell/Navigation, canonical data, auth/security and updater mechanism remain unchanged. OWNER explicitly requested continued work and release before reporting. Release-gate reconciliation updated only superseded filter contracts; product behavior is unchanged. Production remains Owner manual.
